environment.description: Banking microservice deployed on EKS cluster. WebSocket endpoint exposed via AWS NLB (Layer 4) directly to the internet. PgBouncer 1.19 in transaction pooling mode with prepared_statement_mode=auto. No reverse proxy or application-layer gateway in front of the service. CORS headers not applicable to WebSocket upgrade. Service mesh (Istio) sidecar present but configured in PERMISSIVE mTLS mode with no AuthorizationPolicy applied to the workload. Session cookies set with SameSite=None for cross-subdomain SSO compatibility.
